job.title: Senior / Lead Dutch Data & AI Engineer | Azure
job.description:
What will you build?

You'll work hands-on across Data, Cloud & AI, taking solutions from idea through to production:

  • Modern data platforms, pipelines & lakehouses Azure, Microsoft Fabric & Databricks
  • Python, SQL & Spark
  • Azure AI Foundry & Azure OpenAI
  • GenAI, LLMs, RAG & AI Agents
  • CI/CD & MLOps/LLMOps

Their mission is to unlock the real value of data through an intelligent ecosystem — combining Data Engineering, Business Intelligence and Data Science & AI to turn raw data into real business impact. And you won't be hidden behind a backlog.

You'll talk directly to customers, understand their challenges, challenge ideas and help design and build the solution.

Who are we looking for?

You're probably already an experienced Dutch Data Engineer, AI Engineer or ML Engineer with around 5 or more years' experience. Maybe you're already building GenAI solutions. Or perhaps you're a strong Azure Data Engineer moving deeper into AI.

Either way, you're curious, hands-on and want to understand why you're building something — not just how.

Why consider it?
  • Small team
  • Technical leadership
  • Modern Azure & AI stack
  • Direct customer impact
  • Real ownership
  • The opportunity to grow with a consultancy that's going places
  • Permanent contract from the outset
  • A 70/30 basis for salary / bonus to show they’re serious about teamwork and people.

Package: €7500 to €10,500 bruto base + collaborative bonuses depending on level which includes:

  • Laptop
  • 25 days' holiday
  • Flexible working conditions
  • €500 mobility allowance
  • Pension contributions

Requirements added by the job poster
• 3+ years of work experience with SQL
• 3+ years of work experience with Microsoft Azure
• 5+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)
job.salary: Bruto base: €6500 to €10,000 package including collaborative bonuses + car allowance etc

job.title: Data & AI Engineer (GCP) - Hybrid
job.description:
What you’ll work on:
• AI agents & agentic workflows
• Gemini & Vertex AI• RAG & Enterprise Search
• AI voicebots and intelligent assistants
• Python, SQL & BigQuery
• MLOps and taking models into production

You’ll typically work across 2–3 client projects, giving you loads of variety, ownership and exposure to some seriously interesting AI challenges.

What they’re looking for:
  • 3–5 years in Software, Data or ML Engineering
  • Strong Python + SQL
  • GCP / Vertex AI / BigQuery experience is a big plus
  • A builder mentality — you want to ship, not just experiment
  • Comfortable speaking with clients as well as writing code
  • Fluent English - Dutch is an advantage
  • Only EU citizens can be considered for this role

And the package?
  • Up to €90k per annum bruto base
  • Bonus based on billability
  • €850 mobility budget or lease car
  • Google Cloud certifications + dedicated study time
  • MacBook Pro + phone
  • 25 holidays + option to buy 10 more
  • Hybrid working
  • Small, flat team where good ideas beat job titles

If you want to work somewhere that’s genuinely pushing GCP + GenAI from idea → build → production, this is a very cool opportunity.

Requirements added by the job poster
• 2+ years of work experience with Vertex AI
• 1+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)
